decisions.reason: This printer is very close to our core marking systems, was given strong launch visibility, and our in-house hardware and inkjet R&D gives us the absorptive capacity to refine and scale it commercially.

This software module builds directly on our existing variable-data printing knowledge and supports the industry's move toward serialization and traceability, so we can learn from early use and improve it efficiently.
An inkjet coder for non-absorbent surfaces fits our established coding and ink expertise well, making it a product we are well positioned to adapt and exploit across customer applications.

Although more digital than our classic machinery offer, this app is a successor to an existing solution and uses our deep code-reading and traceability knowledge, so it strengthens the broader system around our core products.

Inline code verification is highly complementary to our marking business and to customer demand for compliance and end-to-end traceability, and our related technical knowledge should let us improve it effectively.

This print layout design software builds on our installed base and supports common operation across systems, which fits our strategic direction and can be enhanced through our own R&D and customer feedback.
